facts.recommendationText: Run a demand and funnel diagnostic and a lead-source attribution review Locate where new-customer demand is leaking before any spend change A demand/funnel diagnostic and lead-source attribution are analysis-only and reversible; they avoid cutting or scaling spend blindly. New demand has deteriorated; the funnel must be diagnosed before any marketing change Map top-of-funnel volume, conversion by stage, and channel demand to find the demand leak. The dominant demand/funnel leak is identified by stage and channel Attribute new-customer flow by source to size reversible recovery levers before any spend change. Lead sources attributed and a reversible volume-recovery shortlist drafted
